critical_code_review_comments: OcorrenciaDetail.jsx line 53 — explicit `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` header omits the boundary; browsers/axios normally set it automatically. Works here because axios overrides with FormData, but the manual header is misleading; safer to delete that headers property and let axios/browser build the boundary.
OcorrenciaDetail.jsx line 67 — photos filter accepts either category==='Fotografia' OR file_type startsWith 'image/'; consistent, but no dedup guard if a doc has both — fine today but worth noting.

Thumbnails src uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL absolute URL; relies on cookie samesite=none;secure to send credentials cross-site. Works on the preview domain (same registrable domain) but if the frontend is later hosted on a different domain, thumbnails will 401. Consider using a blob URL fetched via axios (which carries the Bearer fallback) for portability.
onPhotoPick clears e.target.value only after mutate() is dispatched synchronously — good, allows re-selecting the same file after failure.
